location_description: Dubuque ( (listen), dəb-YOOK) is the county seat of Dubuque County, Iowa, located along the Mississippi River. At the time of the 2020 census, the population of Dubuque was 59,667. The city lies at the junction of Iowa, Illinois, and Wisconsin, a region locally known as the Tri-State Area.
